description_en: Submits a screenshot of an individual income tax record for forgery detection and returns a task ID
description_zh: 提交个人所得税记录截图进行伪造检测，返回任务ID
name: CreateImageIncomeTaxDetectionTask

parameters.help_en: The URL of the individual income tax screenshot to be detected. Only HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported, and the image size cannot exceed 10 MB. Images from outside the Chinese mainland are not supported. Only URLs accessible from the public network within the Chinese mainland are supported
parameters.help_zh: 待检测个税截图的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，图片大小不超过 10 MB。暂不支持外网图片，仅支持国内公网可访问的 URL
parameters.name: image_url

Code.description_en: The business error code. `OK` is returned when the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. `200` is returned when the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. `success` is returned when the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the individual income tax screenshot detection task. This ID is used to query the task result by calling the GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult operation
TaskId.description_zh: 个税截图检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult 查询
TaskId.title_en: 个税截图检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult 查询
TaskId.title_zh: 个税截图检测任务 ID，用于后续 GetImageIncomeTaxDetectionTaskResult 查询
